name: delay_integer_pos_neg
description: White-noise reference x and two measurement signals y = x delayed by a known integer number of samples (one positive, one negative) plus uncorrelated noise.

parameters.delay_sign: positive lag = y (measurement) late: y[i] = x[i - lag] + noise
parameters.construction: src = default_rng(seed).standard_normal(n + 2*margin); x = src[margin : margin+n]; y = src[margin-lag : margin-lag+n] + noise_rms * N(0,1) (no circular wrap, no zero fill)
parameters.lag_check: argmax of scipy.signal.correlate(y, x, 'full') with scipy.signal.correlation_lags(n, n, 'full') equals the lag

references: PLAN.md 5.2 (lag sign: positive = measurement late; negative delays first-class)
